post.caption:
5 tips to get promoted as a software engineer (from a new AWS tech lead).

I got promoted to tech lead at AWS this year, right in the AI shift. It wasn't my PR count that did it.

1. Track outcomes, not tickets
2. Own the messy problems
3. Make your decisions visible
4. Ask your manager what the next level expects, now
5. Don't hand your judgment to AI. Own the decision.

Save this for your next promo cycle.
